$comment: `dependency_tier` is a claim about the CODE, not a preference:
dekspec-required  — imports the engine, reads the IR, or keys off the
audit/review model. Meaningless without DekSpec, so
the dependency guard MUST fire when core is absent.
dekspec-enhanced  — zero hard coupling; delivers full primary value
standalone and enriches when DekSpec is detected.
The guard MUST STAY SILENT for these.
The tier is granted on evidence and revoked the moment real coupling
dekspec-enhanced tool's imports so the claim cannot rot into a lie.
Consumed by the dependency guard and (later) the a-la-carte selector.
